---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Duncan Temple Lang <dtemp...@ucdavis.edu>
Date: Thu, Mar 19, 2015 at 3:45 PM
Subject: [datascience-announce] Two upcoming data science workshops for students
To: <datascienc...@ucdavis.edu>


Hi everyone

[Please share this with any group that might be interested - departments, student
 groups, etc.]

We'll be running two 1-day workshops.

 Sat, April  4th:  Web Scraping & Web Services with R

and

 Sat, April 25th:  Data Visualization with R - static and interactive, dynamic displays

Location:   Both workshops will be held on campus, 9.45am - 4.30pm.

These are funded by the NSF, DSI and ISS (Institute for Social Sciences)

Information about the workshops and topics is available at http://datascience.ucdavis.edu/NSFWorkshops/

Instructors: Duncan Temple Lang (member of R core, Prof. UC Davis, Director Data Sciences Initiative, Davis)
             Deb Nolan (Prof. UC Berkeley)
             Authors of the book XML and Web Technologies for Data Sciences with R, and over 100 R packages.

Students should have a basic familiarity with the R programming language (i.e., calling functions and
subsetting data), but do not need to be experts.
We'll use R in the examples, but the concepts apply to other languages.

We have invited students from all over California and Davis students should also apply to attend the workshops via

  https://docs.google.com/a/ucdavis.edu/forms/d/1v25EijG5Z3AuQPyG2P5yjRj5v_hfvaiXeRgt0kDJREk/

Space is limited, so we strongly encourage people to apply as soon as possible, and also
do indicate which workshop(s) you actually plan on attending so that you don't show up and take space
of somebody who would have attended.

These are open to undergraduates and graduate students (and also faculty) and sponsored by the National
Science Foundation (NSF), the UC Davis Data Sciences Intiative and the UC Davis Institute for
Social Sciences.

Email inquiries to dsiwor...@gmail.com


--
Director, Data Sciences Initiative, UC Davis
Professor, Dept. of Statistics, UC Davis
